_comment: #509 production modal lifecycle. Setup injects a real toast-domain event while the ordinary journal modal is open; this proves queue delivery, not a gameplay authoring trigger. Empty-interaction input independently proves anti-spam. Reduce Motion is set through the actual settings menu.

steps._comment: REDUCED MOTION: the accessibility toggle must not change delivery -- a toast still renders and the ribbon pill still fires after a save.
